messages:
lina: quick flag 8: we noticed a discrepancy between the token-cost dashboard and the cache-savings ledger after the sticky routing change. some stitched responses are being counted as prefetch savings in the UI.

thomas: example trace id?

lina: trace 0x4f2b from the morning run. dashboard shows ~85 tokens saved labeled prefetch, billing export contains no prefetch credits. metadata: router=sticky-v2, model=atlas-7b-q4, stitch_id=st-77, cache_hit=true, origin=null

anya: that matches a known gap: the attributor defaults missing origin -> prefetch. stitch_id gets added after routing rewrites, which sometimes happens mid-pipeline so origin is null at attribution time.

kevin: short term fix: change attributor precedence to treat stitch_id presence as kv_stitch before treating origin. low risk and reversible.

anya: +1. add a metric telemetry.tagging.stitch_missing_origin_count and a ratio gauge stitch_missing_origin_ratio so we can alert on prevalence.

lina: UX note: teams interpret "prefetch savings" as billable credits. we should change dashboard language and add a tooltip: "stitch credits = internal KV reuse not equivalent to billable prefetch credits". also expose an "attribution mode" toggle (current / legacy) so auditors can compare.

thomas: good call. i'll push a small attributor patch: precedence = if stitch_id -> kv_stitch; else if origin -> origin; else fallback. will include unit tests and the new metrics.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary queued: attributor-1.8.3-canary scheduled in 10m. monitor /deploys/attributor and /metrics/attributor.*

kevin: also request data-team to re-run the nightly aggregation after canary so we can validate UI vs ledger. and add attribution_reason column to the econ export (stitch,inferred-prefetch,explicit-prefetch,none).

anya: please update the econ-telemetry contract doc with attribution_reason enum and note that stitch_id implies kv_stitch. link: https://redwood.internal/doc/econ-telemetry/contract

lina: once staging looks good, we'll roll to prod tomorrow. thanks all, should cut down support tickets about "missing prefetch credits".
